image_description.short_description: Chanel No. 5 perfume bottle on blue background
image_description.detailed_description: The image features a Chanel No. 5 Eau de Parfum bottle against a soft blue background. The bottle is rectangular with clear glass, showcasing the amber liquid inside. It has a minimalist white label with black text and a distinctive faceted cap. The lighting is soft, highlighting the elegance and luxury of the product. The composition is centered, emphasizing the iconic branding and design of the perfume.
